scope: Only MSVCRT!_write preservation of ESI needed between the two cached calls in write_link_message.
preservation: PUSH ESI at3308 saves caller ESI before overwrite. Both normal and invalid-fd returns restore it: POP ESI335f/RET3360 and POP ESIbb82/RETbb83. Complete wrapper hot/cold extents have no other returns. Cached target loads after format_message; only _write call crosses its lifetime.
source: src/messages.c uses typed _write calls and reads only FILE._file; no graph workaround.
